# Chef Morgan Private Chef & Catering

Chef Morgan provides seasonal private chef and catering services across Hawaiʻi Island, including Kailua-Kona, the Kohala Coast, Waimea, and Hilo.

## Services

- Multi-course private dinners in homes and vacation residences
- Wedding, elopement, and celebration catering
- Retreat and residency dining
- Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and allergy-aware custom menus

## Culinary approach

Menus are ingredient-led, farm-to-table, and shaped by seasonal Hawaiʻi Island produce, local seafood, and guest preferences.

## Availability and booking

Visitors may request a preferred date at https://chefmorgancatering.com/#availability.
A date request is not a confirmed reservation. Every request is reviewed by Chef Morgan before availability is approved. Final proposals and deposits are handled directly.
